title: Gate verdicts are tri-state and a merge requires both gates at threshold
statement: Every gate verdict MUST be PASS, REVIEW, or FAIL, the hard gate MUST emit only PASS or FAIL, a merge MUST require both gates at or above the thresholds in .devai/config/thresholds.json, and a soft-gate evaluation MUST be performed by a model instance distinct from the working agent with no shared context.
rationale: Article 18 makes the soft gate stochastic but bounded by thresholds an adopter may tune, which is why this obligation is a gate rather than a constitutional absolute.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
